description: Use this when you need to check an inbox for new or recent mail (sent and received), for example after sending a message and waiting for a reply. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (optional; inbox id, username, or email — omit to use the account's newest inbox), limit (optional, default 50, max 200). Returns {inbox_id, data:[{id, thread_id, direction, status, from, to, subject, preview, created_at, labels, attachments?}]}, newest first. Previews only, not full bodies: call cooper_get_message to read one message.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit to use the newest inbox.

name: cooper_list_messages
title: List messages
